asked.item: Did I set up the automation wrong?
Why her LINK reply under someone else's comment got nothing
What kind of comment starts a run

verdict.reason: The sentences state directly that a reply to another comment does not start a run, which covers the customer's case.

steps.text: Only top-level comments start a run, so a reply to another comment does not start one.
A reply inside a comment thread is skipped, even when it has a matching keyword.
Only a top-level comment under the post starts a run.
